items.subject: 💌 Your Day Ahead 09/04/2026
items.summary: The daily brief says your childcare eligibility details must be reconfirmed by Monday 7 September to continue receiving Tax-Free Childcare or Free Childcare for Working Parents.
items.action: Sign in to your childcare account through GOV.UK directly and complete the Reconfirmation steps by Monday 7 September.
